symptom: A page moved onto the shared centred shell would render unstyled where its policy has no inline style source: the Ops host sends style-src 'self', and the control plane's pages sent default-src 'none'.
rule: Read the policy a page is served under (its own header, else its host's) before it adopts the inline-styled shell; allow the stylesheet by its CSP hash, pinned by a test that hashes the rendered style.
check: pnpm --dir apps/control-plane exec vitest run src/hosted-page.test.ts
